exam.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with at least one year designing cloud solutions. Practice translating requirements into secure, resilient, high-performing and cost-optimized architectures; identity and multi-account access, VPC/hybrid networking, compute, storage, databases, events/queues, caching, scaling, backup/DR and measured tradeoffs.

review.notes: The current four-domain SAA-C03 guide was reconciled with all detailed domain pages, its live 130-minute/65-question/USD-150 certification page and non-exhaustive service list. The guide treats architecture as requirement-driven tradeoff analysis rather than service memorization. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover federation/multi-account IAM, request-path and data controls; decoupling, scaling, Multi-AZ and measurable DR; compute, storage, database, hybrid networking and ingestion selection; and full-system cost modeling. All 20 URLs are cataloged: 18 reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Current-service/pricing metadata is labeled and no recalled questions are used.
